properties.rationale: User (who:ajs, standing policy from 2026-07-23, applied again 2026-07-25): validation happens through the trials programme — docs/trials/ is where "built the right thing" is exercised against operational intent; formal validation-kind Verification nodes are not this project's tracking mechanism. Re-fired because cap:git-merge-driver joined the set (42 → 43). Unusually well fitted this time, and worth naming why: the driver's tests are run BY GIT on real branches, which is as close to validation as a test gets — and still not validation. What they cannot show is the thing the feature exists for: whether two people on opposite coasts, working different clusters of one design over a week, actually stop losing each other's work. That is a two-person field trial with the parallel-work skill in hand, and it is the first trial this project has had a genuine second participant for.
